description: Dataset of Geological Hazards Survey in Yajiang County, Sichuan Province in 2010 is a data set described in the paper "Dataset of Geological Hazards Survey in Yajiang County, Sichuan Province in 2010" in Acta of Geoscientific Data & Discovery (Editorial Office of Acta of Geoscientific Data & Discovery, 2017), produced by Geoscientific Data & Discovery Publishing System (the data publisher; the open metadata names no authors). A detailed survey of geological disasters at the scales of 1:50000 in Yajiang city was conducted by Chengdu Center of China Geological Survey in 2010, with the intention of finding out the development characteristics and mechanisms of geological disasters in the Tibetan Autonomous Prefecture of Garze. The characteristics, distribution and geological conditions of the geological disasters in the region were identified by remote sensing, survey, engineering mapping and exploration. Coverage: Yajiang County, Sichuan Province, China, at 1:50,000, surveyed in 2010. The data are held on Geoscientific Data & Discovery Publishing System, and the catalogue links the data set first and the paper second; nothing was downloaded, so the file formats and size are not checked. Licence: not stated (no licence in the DataCite metadata read on 2026-10-01). Cost: no charge is stated in the metadata read; the paper's own access terms were not checked. Caveats: written from the paper's abstract and metadata only, so contents, quality and current availability are unchecked and the description may lag the source. It can support geological hazard characteristics and mechanism studies. Related record: the journal-level record for Acta of Geoscientific Data & Discovery.
